items.title: Uniform recurrence construction and four-parameter normalization of bispectral minus-one orthogonal polynomials
items.author: Luis Verde-Star
items.source_version: SIGMA21(2025),083, final form2025-09-18, published2025-10-02; publisher native TeX retrieved2026-10-13
items.difficulty_reason: The counted construction combines a degenerate q=-1 bispectral Newtonian lattice with a uniform parity-dependent Jacobi recurrence family and its four-parameter normalization. Its specialized content is the coherent recurrence construction across the minus-one family, rather than any isolated substitution or example. The full source formulas and normalization argument are retained; simple special cases and direct Bannai-Ito matrix verifications are not counted separately.

primary.label: Counted author classA construction and uniform even/odd recurrence coefficients

proof_spans.label: Complete author four-parameter change, resulting recurrence coefficients and affine normalization argument
